abstract_root_cause: Calculation attempted to divide by a variable that evaluated to zero during full 100% discount calculations.
remediation_pattern: Inspect the denominator before performing division. Add a guard clause checking if denominator == 0 and return a safe fallback value of 0.0.

signature: KeyError: missing key in dictionary lookup
abstract_root_cause: Application attempted direct bracket access on an optional key in a JSON dictionary payload that was not provided.
remediation_pattern: Replace direct bracket access dict[key] with the defensive dict.get(key, default_fallback) method.

signature: IndexError: list index out of range
abstract_root_cause: Requested partition index exceeded the boundary length of the array.
remediation_pattern: Clamp the target index to the maximum permissible index using min(requested_index, len(array) - 1) before lookup.

abstract_root_cause: Function attempted to index a dictionary or object variable that resolved to None when an invalid session was passed.
remediation_pattern: Insert a null check verifying that the object is not None before accessing its fields or attributes.

abstract_root_cause: Input parameter contained a negative number where a positive magnitude was required.
remediation_pattern: Add an input boundary validation check ensuring parameter > 0, clamping or returning a validation error.

signature: TimeoutError: connection timed out during external request
abstract_root_cause: External network call hung without timeout boundary or retry handling.
remediation_pattern: Wrap external HTTP/network call in a try/except block catching TimeoutError and return a graceful failure response.
